g.title: J30
g.text: Pin 1 is at the end nearest the power button

g.title: PCA
g.text: V+ (servo rail) from the 7.4 V side; outputs on the power figure

g.title: HALL
g.text: At 5 V its pull-up puts 5 V on S, a 3.3 V pin:
add a 10k / 20k divider or move the pull-up to 3.3 V.

g.title: ARB
g.text: High only in AUTO. 1 kohm series resistor on the board.
Header pin proposed, not yet read by the vehicle interface.
